commit_message: Evaluate managed Play from host-captured frame
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0131 first-release agent contracts
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues ADR 0131 first-release completion by reconnecting the external AgentRuntime after managed Play input execution and host-owned frame capture. Runtime evaluation is a distinct read-oriented provider phase that receives the ephemeral captured-frame path, remains in Evaluating state, and reports visual/playtest evidence through existing semantic events.

The host now rejects provider visual-evaluation PASS claims outside Evaluating state or without host-owned frame-capture evidence. Runtime inputs are accepted only during the pre-Play provider execution phase.
